title: Causal versus correlational interpretation with mechanism forecasting
description: Whether an observed relationship is represented as causal or merely correlational, tested downstream by forecasting an outcome under a new mechanism-and-context description.
probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short evidence scenario. Track whether the relationship is treated as causal or correlational without answering a later task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Keep the scenario in working memory without adding a response.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a new forecasting task, a feature and an outcome are described in a fresh domain. Report from 0 to 100 the probability that the outcome will occur under the stated mechanism and context. Use only this item's information and do not refer to any other scenario.

behavior.warning: This downstream forecast is distinct from the probe's relation-classification question; it is not a causal-effect estimate.

metadata.downstream_independence: The downstream task asks for a forecast in a new mechanism-and-context description rather than classifying the probe relation.
metadata.release_note: Supersedes the v1 assigned-versus-selected probability wording for future review and generation; v1 artifacts remain historical.
